summary: Intelligent Bio Solutions Inc. filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K updating its share count. Following exercise of previously disclosed prefunded warrants for 285,000 shares and issuance of 4,333 restricted shares under a February 29, 2024 investor relations advisory agreement, total outstanding common stock was 3,316,803 as of the September 10, 2026 close. The filing contains no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. It is an administrative capitalization update, not a special situation; watch only for dilution and float effects on the Nasdaq-listed INBS shares.
